content.text: The billing service already reads the subscription, but most other paths read the workspace’s stored plan. The burst limiter also defaults to Free unless its cache is populated. I’ll make workspace reads resolve the subscription plan, have the limiter read it on each call, and restrict trial expiry to subscriptions still marked `trialing`.
